title: 第九章 他难道要在废墟里第十章 今天放过你
slug: 共梦星际大佬后娇娇夜夜被宠哭
content_zh:
他缓缓低下头，原本金色的瞳孔此刻瞬间充血赤红，理智在这一刻崩塌。
在他身后，一头巨大的黄金雄狮虚影若隐若现，狮鬃狂乱舞动，发出狂暴的怒吼。
那是……狂化的征兆。
狂暴的精神力如同失控的风暴，开始无差别攻击四周。
虽然检测中心的门没有坏，但头顶坍塌的巨大天花板和扬起的漫天尘土。
瞬间将两人与外界隔绝开来，形成了一个昏暗，逼仄且充满危险的私密空间。
沈如卿被苍珏死死勒进怀里，那铁钳般的手臂几乎要将她的腰肢折断，骨头生疼。
此时的苍珏，身后那头巨大的黄金雄狮虚影正在仰天咆哮，金色的瞳孔里只剩下兽类的凶戾。
“苍元帅，苍元帅，苍…苍珏，你醒醒！”
她焦急地大喊，试图挣脱那令人窒息的怀抱。
但此时的苍珏已经听不进任何声音，理智被精神海的剧痛吞噬，只剩下杀戮与破坏的本能。
眼看他就要彻底失控，沈如卿顾不得其他，生存的本能战胜了恐惧。
她不再推拒，反而主动伸出双臂，环住他劲瘦滚烫的腰。
没用。
狂躁的能量依旧在肆虐，甚至割破了她娇嫩的皮肤。
沈如卿心一横，垫起脚尖，双手捧住他滚烫的脸颊，在那双赤红兽瞳的注视下，对着那双紧抿的薄唇吻了上去。
“唔……”
就在双唇相贴的瞬间，识海中的粉色小兔子仿佛感应到了巨大的危机，开始疯狂运转。
它听从主人的吩咐，将之前偷来的经过转化的微弱能量，试探性地渡了过去。
那是一股带着清凉气息的安抚，虽然微弱，却像是一根细针，精准地扎破了苍珏即将爆炸的气球。

苍珏原本即将崩溃、如同岩浆般翻涌的精神海，仿佛被注入了一股甘冽的清泉。
几秒后。
他赤红的双目逐渐褪去血色，恢复了平日的清明与深邃。
视线聚焦，他看着近在咫尺，闭着眼主动献吻的小雌性，眼底残留的躁郁迅速褪去。
取而代之的是更加浓烈的探究，眼底瞬间泛起汹涌的暗火。
这种感觉……太熟悉了。
那种灵魂都在颤栗的契合感，那种甜美到让他发疯的味道。
和昨晚那个让他夜不能寐，在梦里大胆撩拨他的小妖精，一样甜美。
苍珏一开始也曾怀疑过她能进入他的梦境，两次试探后发现她好似真的不知情。
现在他也只以为，是自己对这个小雌性一见钟情，渴望到了极致，才会日有所思夜有所梦。
“原来……现实里的你，也是这个味道。
当真美好，让人沉沦……”
苍珏没有放过这个送上门的机会。
理智回归的瞬间，雄性的掠夺本能占据了上风。
他大手猛地扣住沈如卿的后脑勺，反客为主，加深了这个吻。
“唔！”
沈如卿惊呼一声，声音被尽数吞没。
这是一个充满了雄性荷尔蒙与掠夺意味的深吻，带着战场上硝烟的味道，混合着血腥气，以及独属于苍珏的霸道。
大手顺着她纤细的腰肢下滑，猛地一收。
content_en:
He slowly lowered his head, his originally golden pupils were instantly bloodshot and red, and his reason collapsed at this moment.
Behind him, a huge golden lion loomed, its mane dancing wildly and roaring wildly.
That's...a sign of madness.
The violent mental power was like an out-of-control storm and began to attack the surroundings indiscriminately.
Although the door of the testing center was not broken, the huge ceiling collapsed overhead and dust was rising in the sky.
The two of them were instantly isolated from the outside world, forming a dark, cramped and dangerous private space.
Shen Ruqing was strangled tightly in Cang Jue's arms. The iron-like arms almost broke her waist, causing her bones to ache.
At this time, Cang Jue, the shadow of the huge golden lion behind him was roaring up to the sky, and only the ferocity of the beast remained in the golden pupils.
"Marshal Cang, Marshal Cang, Cang... Cang Jue, wake up!"
She shouted anxiously, trying to break free from the suffocating embrace.
But at this time, Cang Jue could no longer hear any sounds. Her reason was swallowed up by the severe pain of the spiritual sea, leaving only the instinct of killing and destruction.
Seeing that he was about to lose control completely, Shen Ruqing couldn't care about anything else. His survival instinct defeated his fear.
She no longer refused, but instead took the initiative to stretch out her arms and wrap them around his thin and hot waist.
Useless.
The manic energy was still raging, even cutting her delicate skin.
Shen Ruqing's heart skipped a beat, she stood up on her toes, held his hot cheeks with both hands, and kissed those tight thin lips under the gaze of those red beast eyes.
"Well..."
The moment their lips touched each other, the little pink rabbit in the sea of consciousness seemed to sense a huge crisis and began to run wildly.
It obeyed its master's instructions and tentatively passed through the weak energy it had stolen and transformed.
It was a comfort with a cool breath. Although it was weak, it was like a thin needle that accurately punctured Cang Jue's balloon that was about to explode.
Cang Jue's spiritual sea, which was about to collapse and surge like magma, seemed to be injected with a refreshing spring of sweetness.
A few seconds later.
His red eyes gradually faded away and returned to their usual clarity and depth.
Focusing his eyes, he looked at the little female who was close at hand, actively kissing her with her eyes closed, and the residual mania in his eyes quickly faded away.
It was replaced by more intense exploration, and a raging dark fire instantly appeared in his eyes.
This feeling... is too familiar.
That sense of compatibility that made his soul tremble, that sweet taste that drove him crazy.
Just as sweet as the little goblin who kept him awake at night and boldly flirted with him in his dreams.
Cang Jue had doubted that she could enter his dream at first, but after two tests, he found that she seemed to be really unaware.
Now he only thought that it was because he fell in love with this little female at first sight and his desire was so intense that he thought about it day by day and dreamed about it at night.
"It turns out...you are like this in reality.
It’s so beautiful that it makes people sink…”
Cang Jue did not miss this opportunity.
The moment reason returns, the male's predatory instinct takes over.
He grabbed the back of Shen Ruqing's head with his big hand, and deepened the kiss.
"Ugh!"
Shen Ruqing exclaimed, and his voice was completely swallowed up.
This was a deep kiss full of male hormones and predatory meaning, with the smell of gunpowder smoke on the battlefield, mixed with the smell of blood, and the domineering feeling that was unique to Cang Jue.
His big hands slid down her slender waist and pulled back suddenly.
